relations.subject: Gopinath Kaviraj
relations.evidence: Kaviraj was the posthumous son of Vaikunthanath, a Bengali scholar of philosophy.

relations.subject: Gopinath Kaviraj
relations.evidence: In 1906 he moved to Jaipur, where after four years he obtained a Bachelor of Arts degree from Maharaja College, Jaipur.

relations.subject: Gopinath Kaviraj
